scope: Preliminary static audit of supplied Windows 2000 kernel; memory manager not executed by this probe.

observations.finding: Initial descriptor scan skips types 6, 23 and 22; type 26 is counted in physical pages.
Free candidate selection only accepts types 2,4,5,8; type 26 is not a free candidate.
Type values greater than 23 branch to generic allocated-page handling at RVA 0x159802, rather than the free-list branch at 0x159762.

conclusion: Type 26 is not immediately classified as free in these inspected loops. This is not a complete compatibility proof.
remaining: Audit later reclamation and phase-1 paths.
Check reserved low pages remain mapped and valid as NT5 initializes memory.
Select next halt before HAL return is enabled.
